review.notes: Independent source-evidence re-review verified 3 frozen Git blobs and exact SHA-256 values at 0f1be24f711b1fada8dd35a1554d4710d7fa6cd6. Independent review confirms that the repository is Bun-managed, the exact bun.lock hash, and the root install cwd. Neither package.json nor README pins a Bun version, and no runtime file, container, or CI workflow authenticates candidate Bun 1.3.10 on Linux x64; exact frozen-install validation is required before approval.

sourceEvidence.statement: Frozen root Bun text lock is bound for deterministic bun install --frozen-lockfile preparation.
Manifest defines Bun-oriented project scripts but contains no engines or packageManager version.
Frozen project instructions use root bun install and bun run commands but do not pin a Bun release.
